items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: later on, I met his son, and he told me his dad had told him about me and his son--after I had my big band--he was one of the features at the Apollo Theatre and the Royal Theatre with my band.

ctx.x: The men, frankly speaking, just relived that whole time (inaudible), and you know what you can do and it's all right, and of course they would allow (inaudible).

It would just tickle him to death and everything, and later on, I met his son, and he told me his dad had told him about me and his son--after I had my big band--he was one of the features at the Apollo Theatre and the Royal Theatre with my band.
